summary: Comprehensive testing of No Limit Delivery multi-service platform. Backend: 11/11 tests passing (100%). Frontend: Core features working but login navigation bug persists from previous iterations, blocking checkout flow.

minor.issue: Delivery fee was hardcoded as R3.99 in Order model instead of R25
minor.fix_applied: Updated create_order endpoint to explicitly set delivery_fee=25.00 when creating orders

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Login with test@demo.com / test123 does NOT navigate to home screen. Backend API works perfectly (verified via curl), but frontend login button click doesn't trigger navigation. The useProtectedRoute hook in _layout.tsx should redirect when isAuthenticated becomes true, but this doesn't happen. Same bug from iterations 1 and 2.
integration_issues.workaround: Users can navigate directly to /home after entering credentials (session is created but navigation doesn't happen)
integration_issues.rca: The login() function in authStore sets isAuthenticated=true, but the useProtectedRoute useEffect in _layout.tsx doesn't trigger navigation. Likely a React state update timing issue or Expo Router navigation issue in web preview.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Proceed to Checkout' doesn't navigate to checkout screen because it requires authentication (isAuthenticated check in cart.tsx line 31). Since login doesn't work, user is not authenticated, so checkout is blocked.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead (React Native Web deprecation)
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix login navigation bug - useProtectedRoute in _layout.tsx not triggering navigation after successful login. This blocks the entire authenticated user flow including checkout.
Consider alternative navigation approach: Add explicit router.replace('/(tabs)/home') in login.tsx after successful login instead of relying on useProtectedRoute
Update shadow* style props to boxShadow across all components to remove deprecation warnings
Add testID attributes to login form inputs for better automated testing
critical_code_review_comments: Backend Delivery Fee Bug (FIXED): Order model had default delivery_fee=3.99 but requirements specify R25. Fixed by explicitly setting delivery_fee in create_order endpoint.

Login Navigation Bug (UNFIXED): This is the same bug from iterations 1 and 2. The backend API works perfectly, session_token is created, but frontend navigation doesn't happen. The useProtectedRoute hook should redirect when isAuthenticated becomes true, but the useEffect doesn't trigger. This is a complex Expo Router + React state timing issue.
Checkout Blocked: Checkout requires authentication, so it's blocked by the login bug. Once login is fixed, checkout should work.
All backend APIs are 100% functional with correct ZAR pricing (R25 delivery, 15% VAT)
Service type filtering works perfectly (food, laundry, parcel, florist)
Multi-restaurant cart support is implemented correctly in cartStore
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed delivery fee from R3.99 to R25)

Frontend loads and most features work: home screen shows service tabs (All, Food, Laundry, Parcels, Flowers), filtering works, categories display correctly, restaurant detail loads, menu shows ZAR prices, add to cart works, cart shows correct calculations. The CRITICAL blocker is login navigation - clicking Sign In doesn't navigate to home despite successful API call. This blocks checkout flow since checkout requires authentication. Same bug from iterations 1 and 2.
